note: Mutants of the door for the admin page's calls to the chat hub in docker/nginx.conf (/hub/admin/api/: the map of the calls that the hub has, the checks, the headers that go on, the body's size, the allowance and the log; docs/HUB_ROLES.md 'The admin page's door') for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'): each breaks one rule on purpose, and tests/scripts/test_nginx_hub_admin_api.py must notice, running the real blocks in front of a stand-in hub and in front of the real hub. Run from the checkout, no build needed, where the program nginx is installed: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/nginx_hub_admin_api_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1.

mutants.old:
default "";
    "~^GET /hub/admin/api/
mutants.new:
default read;
    "~^GET /hub/admin/api/

mutants.old: (?:me|bans|mutes|hidden|imagesoff|modlog|status)\z" read;
mutants.new: (?:me|bans|mutes|hidden|imagesoff|modlog|status|ban)\z" read;

mutants.old: "~^GET /hub/admin/api/(?:me
mutants.new: "~^[A-Z]+ /hub/admin/api/(?:me

mutants.old:
if ($hub_admin_call = "") { return 404; }
        if ($is_args) { return 404; }
mutants.new: if ($is_args) { return 404; }

mutants.old: proxy_pass http://$ants_hub$uri;                          # (the normalized path, never the raw request line: the map above has let nothing else through)
mutants.new: proxy_pass http://$ants_hub$request_uri;
